page.layout: One page of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Below the text: "FINIS" and "SOLI DEO GLORIA", both centred. A library stamp and a digitiser's watermark are not transcribed.

main_text.l: {q}Papa (vt vester Episcopus asserit) cum seipsum absoluere
non potest, absoluitur à subdito. Audin'? à Subdito quum
itaque huic ministerio se Papa subdit, nonnon interea
Summus agnosci debeat? Exemplo res fiet dilucidior.
{r}Confessarius (inquis) duas gerit personas, & Iudicis,
& Medici. Papa itaque fidem curámque Corporis sui Medico
dat; quando igitur Medicus Papae tangit venas, pal-
pat latera, vrinam explorat, & velut in statera ægrotan-
tis humores expendit; deinde ægroto medicamenta præ-
scribit, iubet insolita, consueta prohibet, arguit oblata,
execratur exhibita, authoritate & arbitrio suo omnia or-
dinat, atque disponit; cui Papa, si sanus esse velit, suâ
sponte obtemperat; quasi esset Medicus [illegible,
~8 letters]: si vero se ille nimis Medicum esse meminerit, & ministe-
rij oblitus Pontifici se vestro Superiorem iactitaret; quis
non ipsum Medicum, (quod pari ratione de Confessario
dicendum) tanquàm Medico egentem, ad Anticyras o-
cyus ablegandum duxerit? Viden', Lector, quàm ef-
foeta & languida sint hæc, quæ Cardinalis affert?
Quan-
quam quem toto itinere hactenùs vacillantem
& hæsitantem experti sumus, mirandum
non est, si eundem videamus
deficere.
FINIS.
SOLI DEO GLORIA.

page.notes: Text centred in the lower part: the closing lines "Quanquam quem ..." are set as centred lines and are transcribed as one paragraph. The Greek phrase after "quasi esset Medicus" is set in small italic type and could not be read; it is marked illegible. The reference mark "q" in the text is written as {q}, and "r" as {r}. Mark "col.2." printed in the note is kept. The library stamp (Biblioteca Romana, Vittorio Emanuele) and the "Digitized by Google" watermark are not part of the printed page and are left out.
